description: Search Walmart products. Paginate with page while has_more_pages. 1 credit (US/CA), 2 credits (Mexico). Optional store targeting: pass delivery_zip + store_id together (store_id from get_walmart_stores, same domain) for one store's assortment and availability - walmart.com and walmart.ca only, 2 credits, takes 10-60s, store echoed in data.location.

delivery_zip.description: Shopper postal code: 5-digit US ZIP, or Canadian postal code (e.g. 'M5V 2T6') with domain 'ca'. Must be passed with store_id.

fulfillment_type.description: 'in_store' for pickup only. Omit for all.

store_id.description: Walmart store id from get_walmart_stores (same domain). Must be passed with delivery_zip. The store used is echoed in data.location.

name: search_walmart
